headline: ML maps multiomic and cfDNA profiles to prognostic and diagnostic outcomes
label: Ml Molecular Biomarker Prediction
summary: Multi-omic and fragmentomic datasets are being modeled without imputation, fixed panels or high sequencing depth.
synthesis: The common thread is supervised machine learning applied to molecular measurements for prediction in individual patients. The stacking-bagging ensemble fuses clinical, expression and CNV data for breast cancer prognosis on METABRIC, reporting ROC AUC 0.9355. DeepGxP predicts protein and phosphoprotein abundance from pan-cancer and single-cell transcriptomes, and DeepFRAG applies wavelet transforms and deep learning to cfDNA fragment size profiles from low-depth whole-genome sequencing for cancer detection. ADAPT-MS retrains simple classifiers per sample on quantified plasma and CSF proteins without imputation or fixed panels. What is new is the attention to data constraints: per-sample adaptation, avoidance of imputation, and signal transformation of sparse fragmentomic data, rather than architecture alone.
